verdict.rationale: Pipedream is a workflow automation platform. Its workflows fire unattended from schedule, HTTP/webhook, email, RSS and app-event triggers, and deployed event sources run hosted on Pipedream. Built-in retries and error emails support unattended operation, and a community user describes an Airtable base that auto-feeds an Algolia index. Missing for 10: detailed evidence that AI agents (only a one-line 'deploy AI agents' claim) run autonomously in the background, and current execution-limit and runtime-duration documentation (the only figures are old community-reported limits, e.g. 30s for cron).
